label: Diagnosed, treatment not started
guideline: First treatment within 30 days of diagnosis (time-to-treatment standard)

label: Systemic cycle without a recent blood count
guideline: Full blood count within 7 days before each chemotherapy / immunotherapy cycle

label: Rising tumour marker after treatment
guideline: Investigate a rising, above-range marker for recurrence

label: High risk, no palliative review
guideline: Early palliative care for patients with a high risk of dying within a year
